blocks.text: National University Cebu unveiled five new college academic programs and its strengthened Senior High School Career Pathways on October 2, 2026, giving students in Cebu and neighboring provinces more options to explore careers shaped by changing industries, technology and their own interests. The new programs, BA Communication, BS Management Accountancy, BS Computer Engineering, Bachelor of Multimedia Arts, and AB Political Science, are part of the university’s continuing expansion of academic opportunities in the region. While the programs were formally presented during the press presentation, enrollment had already opened on July 13, 2026. For NU Cebu, the expansion is not simply about […]...
